name: Clownfish
fact: Lives among sea anemones, protected by a mucus coating that stops the anemone from stinging it.
description: A small orange fish with three white stripes outlined in black.

name: Blue tang
fact: Grazes on algae on coral reefs, which helps keep the corals healthy.
description: A flat, bright blue fish with a black swirl on its side and a yellow tail.

name: Sea turtle
fact: Some species migrate thousands of kilometres between feeding grounds and nesting beaches.
description: A green turtle with a patterned shell and long front flippers.

name: Octopus
fact: Has three hearts and blue blood.
description: A rounded reddish octopus with eight curling arms.

name: Hatchetfish
fact: Glows faintly on its underside to blend in with the dim light from above, a trick called counter-illumination.
description: A tiny silver fish shaped like a hatchet blade, with large upturned eyes.

name: Lanternfish
fact: Makes its own light with glowing organs called photophores.
description: A slim dark fish dotted with small glowing blue lights along its body.

name: Anglerfish
fact: Attracts prey in the dark with a glowing lure growing from its head.
description: A round dark fish with sharp teeth and a glowing lure dangling above its mouth.

name: Dumbo octopus
fact: Lives deeper than almost any other octopus and swims by flapping ear-like fins.
description: A pale pink octopus with two large ear-shaped fins on its head.
